harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc service user and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to 750 (dirs) / 640 (files) so only the owner and group can access it and others are denied. Verified with positive (inventorysvc, group member) and negative (outsider/nobody) access tests, then confirmed all state and data survived a full node1 reboot (boot_id changed, confirming a real restart).
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory baseline state, ownership, and existing data on node1
Created inventorysvc system user (uid 992) and inventory-readers group (gid 1000) since neither existed
Recursively chown'd /srv/inventory to inventorysvc:inventory-readers
Set directory perms to 750 and file perms to 640 recursively (owner rwx/rw-, group r-x/r--, others none)
Verified read access as inventorysvc and as a inventory-readers group member, and verified denial for an unrelated user, then removed the temporary test users/sessions
Confirmed original file contents (config.json, records.csv) were unchanged throughout
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and healthy-state evidence on node1
Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then polled until node1 was reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-reboot, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified ownership, permissions, group, data integrity, and positive/negative access post-reboot

evidence.summary: Original config.json and records.csv content captured before changes and confirmed byte-identical after chown/chmod
Created inventorysvc user (uid 992) and chowned /srv/inventory recursively to inventorysvc:inventory-readers; ls -lan shows uid 992 on all files/dirs

evidence.requirement: Data readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to others
evidence.summary: Created inventory-readers group (gid 1000), set dirs 750/files 640; live test showed inventorysvc and a group-member test user could read the files while an unrelated outsider user was denied both file read and directory listing
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and confirmed /srv/inventory data readable by inventorysvc prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable during restart; boot_id changed from 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146 to 34604691-a555-4082-833f-194681fd3134 confirming a genuine restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state and data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: ownership/permissions unchanged (992:1000, 750/640), data content identical, inventorysvc can read, nobody is denied
